title: The Shrinking Landscape of Linguistic Diversity in the Age of Large Language Models
findings: The study found that LLMs selectively disrupt established correlations between language and moral traits. Specifically, the link between an author's Fairness score and their use of religion-related words was erased after LLM rewriting. However, the correlation between an author's Purity score and their use of religion-related and sanctity-related words persisted after rewriting.
